info.title: Wikipedia Search, ECB Exchange Rates & Treasury Yields
info.description:
Search Wikipedia, or fetch ECB euro FX rates and U.S. Treasury yields.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/wikipedia-search
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/wikipedia-search
Author: Public Records.
